name: Imbricate
description: Overlapping scales laid like roof tiles, every course stepped half a scale across.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 0 0 50% 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@y % 2 == 1) { -webkit-transform: translateX(50%); transform: translateX(50%); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
